answer: Because the timing is recorded against the vine challenge, the ridge audit can replay the island history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 281 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. A scripted farm thus has to pad 118 submissions and hold each account open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
